claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0000 extracts paragraph (a)(3)(iii)(A), but leaves modality as uncertain and omits the governing lead-in scope from paragraph (a)(3)(iii) (occupying an approved child restraint system furnished by the operator or designated persons, notwithstanding other chapter requirements). Referencing § 91.107(a)(3)(iii) by citation alone does not supply the missing governing conditions. Structured fields for actor, action, and object are empty, but the core relationship is otherwise stated.

unit_judgments.rationale: Claim C0000 captures the requirement for accompaniment by a parent, guardian, or designated attendant during flight, but only partially covers U0000 because it omits the governing lead-in terms (the context of occupying an approved child restraint system furnished by the operator or listed persons) and leaves modality unresolved as uncertain.
